engine._notes: mode: 'mock' (test UI without opencode) or 'opencode'. The command array is a template; {prompt} and {cwd} are replaced at run time. Verify flags with `opencode run --help` on your machine - e.g. add '--model', or session flags - and adjust here. No code changes needed.

scheduler._notes: Runs the Scout (collector) once per day at collectorTime while the server is running. For runs even when Spindle is closed, use Windows Task Scheduler instead - see docs/extending.md.

doctor._notes: Readiness check ('node server.js --check' / GET /api/doctor). cacheTtlMs is how long a cached result in runs/.doctor.json stays fresh before /api/state and /api/doctor re-probe; pass ?refresh=1 to force a re-check. Default 1h.
